regions.merged_text: You've been on my mind frequently these days. I wanted to write you but getting aquainted in a new place keeps one on edge pretty much. I inscribed the names you sent me recently thru Rae Garland and I am surely pleased to know your able to keep up the good work. Thanks be to God. The above Monastery is where I made my annual retreat last week. It is across the Hudson from Lady Cliff convent and West Point Military College - the latter about a mile and a half up. Thank God it is quite an ideal place for quiet reflection and study. About 75 priests, Clerics and lay brothers, ...
